; The installer gates exact firmware and applies after the existing AppLoad.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Sidebar.qml
    IMPORT org.reweread.Downloader 1.0
    TRAVERSE FocusScope > ColumnLayout#filterColumn
        LOCATE AFTER ArkControls.SidebarFoldout#integrationsFoldout
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.SidebarItem {
                id: wereadDownloaderSidebar
                objectName: "wereadDownloaderSidebar"
                text: "微信读书下载"
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/import"
                highlighted: Downloader.opened
                onTriggered: { root.toggle(); Downloader.openPage() }
                Layout.preferredHeight: Common.Values.navigatorSidebarItemHeight
                Layout.preferredWidth: parent.width
                Component.onCompleted: Downloader.placeBelowAppLoad(wereadDownloaderSidebar)
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    IMPORT org.reweread.Downloader 1.0
    TRAVERSE Background#root > FocusScope#rootItem
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: wereadDownloaderHost
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 10000
                visible: Downloader.opened
                onVisibleChanged: { if (!visible && Downloader.opened) Downloader.closePage() }
                Component.onCompleted: Downloader.attachSettings(Settings)
                Loader {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    active: Downloader.opened
                    source: "qrc:/weread-downloader/DownloaderPage.qml"
                }
                Connections {
                    target: Downloader
                    function onRestoreRequested(uuid, page, bookId) {
                        let entry = Library.entryForId(uuid);
                        if (!entry || page < 0 || page >= entry.pageCount) {
                            Downloader.completeRestore(bookId, false);
                            return;
                        }
                        LibraryController.setLastOpenedPage(entry.id, page);
                        Qt.callLater(function() { Downloader.completeRestore(bookId, entry.lastOpenedPage === page); });
                    }
                }
                Connections {
                    target: PowerManager
                    function onPowerButtonShortPress() { Downloader.closePage() }
                }
                Connections {
                    target: Qt.application
                    function onStateChanged() {
                        if (Qt.application.state !== Qt.ApplicationActive) Downloader.closePage()
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
